literal_meaning: আলট (উল্টো বা উলটপাল্টা) + পকা (হঠাৎ পড়া বা আছড়ে পড়া)
figurative_meaning_en: suddenly; unexpectedly; all of a sudden without warning
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আলটপকা চলে গেল বাড়ি থেকে।
example_sentences_in_english: He left home all of a sudden.
note: This is a colloquial adverb widely used in spoken Bengali to denote abruptness, rooted in everyday linguistic evolution rather than a specific proverb.
